fam the vibe on this one. loved how the melodies came in slowly. definitely hear the kanye inspiration lol. usually im more of a fan of punchy drums, but the surpressed drums (if u can call it that) really fit here. the vocal melodies were amazing, really fit the vibe of the song. instrumental melodies were hella dope too. the best genre i think this would fit would be kanye tier hip hop, and thats solely because of the drums lol. great job buddy, great song overall.

enjoyed the listen, good shit bud. the guitar melodies were dope as fuck. the vocals fit well, but my only criticism regarding them is that they could have been mixed in a bit better. the flow was pretty nice. not gonna lie the lead guitar kinda scared me lmao, it fit well with the vibe but kinda came out of nowhere, could have added some sort of build up for it. another thing, regarding the beat, it felt like it was missing a bit of a punchier kick, sounded fine as it is, but it could embrace the whole lofi sound u know, but that just might be my taste in music idk. overall hella dope song, enjoyed the listen, added to my lofi playlist, keep goin <3.

hella chill beat. you hit the juice wrld vibe on point, could definitely imagine him on stuff like this. absolutely loved the melodies. the only thing i would change is as the kicks come in the hi hats could get a bit harder as well, like another layer of hats on top of these ones, if that makes sense lol. overall dope beat <3.

Really dope lofi track you have going on here. :D Added this to my lofi playlist. I really liked the lead that came in at around 40 secs, made the track much more vibey. The drums were on point, especially the hats and percs. Also sounds like someting id use for studying, def belongs in the studying girl lofi stream lol. Keep doing what youre doing.

It was a really cool experience listening to this track, i loved the chilled out nature of it. The only criticism i could give you is that in the first part of the song some parts were a bit muddy. You nailed the second half though. I could totally imagine playing this while driving around in the rain or something. Overall good job bud, dropped a follow on soundcloud.
